Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from this game. Australia have bounced back in convincing fashion and have levelled the series. On the other hand, it was a forgetful game for India and they need to start afresh in the series decider. The third and final ODI of the series will be played at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai on Wednesday, 22nd of March. The first ball will be bowled at 1.30 pm IST (8.00 am GMT). As always, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Mitchell Starc is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant five-wicket haul. He says that he has learnt his trade over the years. Adds that he has been in good rhythm of late and was able to swing the ball. Mentions that his conversation are different from those like Cameron Green or Marcus Stoinis as they bowl different lengths. Tells that both wickets helped the seamers and adds that his plan is to attack the stumps.

Steven Smith, the victorious skipper of Australia, says that the bowlers were outstanding in this game. Adds that Mitchell Starc put India under early pressure and he was complimented well by other bowlers. Shares that he did not know how the wicket would play and did not have any totals in mind. Feels that it was just about going out there and putting the batters under pressure. Mentions that it was one of those days where they nicked everything and it went into hands. Credits Travis Head and Mitchell Marsh for the start and for putting pressure on the opposition bowlers. Also says that it was a good day and he is really proud of the effort. Ends by saying that he is glad the ball stuck in his hand since Hardik Pandya is an unbelievable player.

Rohit Sharma, the captain of India says that is a bit disappointing to lose like this and they did not play to their potential. Adds that they could not apply themselves with the bat and says that this was not a 117 pitch at all. Tells that whenever they were trying to build a partnership they kept losing wickets which was not ideal. Mentions that when he and Virat Kohli added 30-35 runs quickly, they thought about putting pressure back on Australia, but he lost his wicket and then a couple more which put them on the back foot. Credits Mitchell Starc for his bowling effort and says that he has always been a quality bowler and bowled to his strengths and kept the batters guessing by swinging the ball both ways. Reckons Mitchell Marsh is one of the top players going around when it comes to power-hitting.
Presentation Time...

Mitchell Marsh and Travis Head are in for a quick chat. Marsh says that they had fun and it was important to get off to a fine start. Shares that he made sure he was watching the ball. Feels that it is exciting to open the innings with only two fielders outside the 30-yard circle for the first ten overs. Credits Mitchell Starc for putting India under pressure in the first Powerplay of both games. Also says that it is going to be a big third game for them. Travis Head says that it was nice to contribute. Shares that he was settled and took his time. Feels that it is nice when Mitchell Marsh is hitting like he was hitting in this game. Mentions that he was hoping either of them would get going but here, both got going which is rare.

Earlier in the game, after being asked to bat first, India were bowled out for a mere total of 117 runs courtesy a five-wicket haul from Mitchell Starc. The hosts would have been disappointed with that effort, and will need to work on that. However, they would have thought to make some early inroads and put pressure on the Aussie batters, but failed to do so and in the end, the opening pair of Mitchell Marsh and Travis Head eased past them to chase the total in no time which makes the 3rd ODI a bit more interesting now.

Australia knew that they needed a good start when they came out to bat and try not give any openings to the hosts. Mitchell Marsh and Travis Head did exactly and smashed each and every bowler out of the park. They made this chase look like a cakewalk. Marsh remained unbeaten on 66 with six massive hits and off just 36 balls while Head also registered an unbeaten half-century. However, this win was set up by the bowlers and in the end they level the series in some style. Australia also becomes the only team to win an ODI against India by 10 wickets. India, on the other hand will need to erase this game from their memories and come out with a positive intent in the decider.

What a dominating victory for the Aussies! They win by 10 wickets with 234 balls to spare, and also hands the hosts their biggest defeat in regards to balls remaining. India were hoping to make a match out of this but they were absolutely blown away by the Marsh-Head storm who took their side over the line without breaking a sweat.

FOUR! Mitchell Marsh ends with a flourish! Axar Patel bowls it short and outside off, Mitchell Marsh gets into a good position on the back foot. Slaps it hard and wide of point for a boundary to get Australia over the line. Australia win by 10 wickets and level the series.
Short and on off, Mitchell Marsh punches it to cover for a dot.
Short and at the pads, Travis Head nudges this one behind square on the leg side for a single. Scores level now.

FIFTY for Travis Head! Short and around leg, Travis Head uses his feet and turns this one towards deep backward square leg and collects a couple of runs to bring up his fifty. He has taken the backseat in the partnership but this has been still a fine knock.

DROPPED! Sums up India's day, nothing has gone their way. Flighted, full on middle, Travis Head gets down on one knee and goes for the slog sweep. Skies this one high in the air towards long on. Mohammad Shami stationed there runs across to his left and gets there but fails to hang onto it.
Darted in full on off, Travis Head can only push this one back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Continues to bowl short at the stumps but much slower this time, Travis Head rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg. Keeps the strike with a single.
FOUR! Kuldeep Yadav bowls it short and on middle and leg, the ball keeps low but Travis Head still manages to get underneath the delivery and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Qucker again and on a short length, Mitchell Marsh gets hurried on the pull and ends up pushing it uppishly towards long on for a run.
Short and quicker on off, Mitchell Marsh creates room to go through the off side but toe ends it back to the bowler.

SIX! Mitchell Marsh is showing no mercy here! Short again and on middle, Mitchell Marsh picks the length early and sits deep in his crease. Latches onto the pull shot and deposits it towards the mid-wicket fence for a 97 metre six.
Starts with a flatter delivery on off, Mitchell Marsh makes room and punches hard but finds extra cover.
Kuldeep Yadav comes into the attack now.
On a yorker length on middle, Travis Head digs this one out back to the bowler.
Short and around off, Mitchell Marsh stays back in his crease and punches it down to long off for a single. 100 comes up for Australia.
Tossed up, full on middle and leg, Travis Head gets down and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Travis Head! Fired in full and on middle, Travis Head steps out and swats this one towards the vacant backward square leg region for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Travis Head gets into the act now! Short and outside off by Axar Patel, Travis Head goes back and cuts this one past point for a boundary.
Short and flatter on middle, Travis Head uses his feet to whip this one but misses and gets rapped on the back leg.
On a length and on off, Mitchell Marsh goes for the big heave again, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FIFTY FOR MARSH! He gets to in some style as well! This is short and on middle, Mitchell Marsh waits for it as clubs it over the long on fence for another biggie. This has been a swash-buckling knock from him.

SIX! BOOM! Mitchell Marsh shows his strength again! Hardik Pandya tries another slower delivery, on length and on middle, Mitchell Marsh stays in his crease and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
On a length and on middle, Mitchell Marsh blocks it down the pitch.
Back of a length and outside off, shaping away, Mitchell Marsh slashes hard at it, but misses.

SIX! Up, up and away! Mitchell Marsh greets Hardik Pandya with a massive hit. Hardik Pandya begins with a slower delivery, full and on middle, Mitchell Marsh picks it up early and smokes it well over the long off fence and into the second tier for a biggie.
Change from both ends as Hardik Pandya comes on from the other end.
Flighted and on off, Mitchell Marsh uses his feet and knocks it towards long off for a run.
FOUR! Solid shot! This is quicker, but too full and around off, Mitchell Marsh is not going to let go off that and drills it through covers for a boundary.
Short and on middle, Mitchell Marsh moves back and punches it towards covers.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mitchell Marsh goes down for the sweep, but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Floated, full and on middle, Mitchell Marsh goes for the drive, but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Axar Patel starts with a flatter delivery, full and on middle, Travis Head drills it towards long on for a single.
Axar Patel comes on to bowl.
Short and on leg, Travis Head pulls it on the bounce towards deep backward square leg for just a run. 17 runs off the over then!

FOUR! Four boundaries in a row! This is on a hard length and and on off, Travis Head stays there and slaps it, but does not time it that well. However it has enough legs to go past mid off for another boundary.
EDGED AND FOUR! Mohammed Siraj bangs in a short ball and on middle, Travis Head hops up and goes for the pull shot, but gets a top edge over the keeper's head for four more runs.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! This is a bit short and around leg, Travis Head swivels and hooks it towards the fine leg fence for another boundary.
FOUR! Nice shot! Mohammed Siraj lands this on a good length and on middle, Travis Head makes some room and clips it well over mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up for Australia!
This is on a hard length and on off, Travis Head pushes it wide of short extra covers.
On a length and on off, Mitchell Marsh keeps it out to the off side. 16 runs off the over!
Short of a length and around off, Mitchell Marsh punches it hard, but finds the covers fielder this time.

SIX! Mitchell Marsh has sent this a long way into the crowd! Mohammad Shami bowls this short again on middle, Mitchell Marsh picks up the length early and absolutely hammers it flat and over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Back of a length and on off, Mitchell Marsh pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! SMASHED! Mohammad Shami lands this short and around off, Mitchell Marsh this time thrashes it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.

SIX! BANG! Mitchell Marsh looks in a hurry! Mohammad Shami bowls this on a good length and on middle, shaping in, Mitchell Marsh stays in his crease and swings through the line, it is not from the middle of the bat, but has enough power to take it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.

FOUR! Travis Head connects this time alright! Mohammed Siraj goes for another bouncer, on middle, but this time it sits up nicely for the batter, Travis Head gets into position quickly and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Good bowling! Mohammed Siraj bangs in a sharp bouncer, on middle and off, Travis Head tries to pull it, but misses.
Back of a length again and around leg, Travis Head looks to clip it away, but misses and gets hit high on his body as the ball stays on the pitch.
Back of a length and around off, Travis Head cuts it towards point.
On a length and around off again, Mitchell Marsh tries to punch hard at it, but gets an inside edge past the stumps and through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Powered away! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a hard length and outside off, Mitchell Marsh accepts the room and muscles it through extra covers for a boundary.
Touch fuller and on middle, Mitchell Marsh tucks it wide of short mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on off, Mitchell Marsh mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Mohammad Shami bangs in a bouncer, on middle and off, but this goes way abover Mitchell Marsh as he tries to pull it. It is called a wide for height.
Back of a length and around off, shaping in, Mitchell Marsh tries to punch it away, but misses this time.
FOUR! Up and over! Mohammad Shami serves this full and on middle, Mitchell Marsh is waiting for that and just lofts it over mid on for another boundary. Australia need less than 100 runs now!
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Mohammad Shami lands this short of a length and just around off, Mitchell Marsh stays there and gets on top of the bounce to smash it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Mitchell Marsh keeps it out in front of covers.
Short and well down the leg side, Mitchell Marsh looks to pull it away, but misses. Wided.
Length again and around off, Mitchell Marsh taps it wide of point where Axar Patel dives to his right to stop it. They cross.
This is on good length and on off, Mitchell Marsh knocks it towards mid off.

Back of a length and on off, Travis Head pushes it towards covers and sets off for the run, Virat Kohli picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end, but misses and Head makes his ground quite easily in the end.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Head! Mohammed Siraj bangs this short and outside off, Travis Head frees his arms and punches it over point for four more runs.

FOUR! The first boundary of the innings comes from the bat of Head. Mohammed Siraj lands this on a hard length and around leg, Travis Head waits for it and flicks it with great timing towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle, Travis Head looks to play at it, but gets a leading edge towards mid off on.
Mohammed Siraj tries to begin with a slower bouncer, on middle, but it is way above the head height, Travis Head ducks under it. It is also called a wide for height.
It will be Mohammed Siraj to operate from the other end.

Another full delivery, on middle, shaping in again, Mitchell Starc tries to clip it away, but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball rolls down the pitch. If he would have missed that, it was plumb.
Touch fuller and around middle and leg, shaping in, Mitchell Marsh looks to work it away, but misses and gets hit on the pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Back of a length and around off, Travis Head steers it through point for a single and gets off the mark.
Australia are underway with extras! Mohammad Shami strays from his line and serves this full, but down the leg side, Travis Head misses his flick. Wided.
Short of a length and outside off, Travis Head chops it down towards point.
Full again and on off, Travis Head drives it straight towards wide mid off.
Mohammad Shami starts with a fuller-length delivery around off, Travis Head blocks it out towards mid off.
